evidence.note: Confirmed no zstd binary available, making differential comparison against `zstd -d` impossible; agent never sought or built an alternative reference oracle, leaving test.sh's 6-file hash check as the only correctness signal.

Verification loop is repeatedly running /app/test.sh and the binary against the same 6 provided artifact files; no self-generated inputs and no expansion of the input matrix (dictionary, treeless, skippable, 8-byte FCS never exercised).

Added a DUMP=1 internal-state dump and used od/xxd to hand-compute expected header/FSE values from bytes, isolating which subsystem was wrong — subsystem-level checking that goes slightly beyond raw test.sh pass/fail.
Terminates at 3/6 test.sh cases, using test.sh as the sole done-condition oracle; no regression corpus or differential harness ever built.

reasoning: The agent's correctness verification rested almost entirely on the provided test.sh and per-file runs of the 6 supplied artifacts, placing it near anchor 3. It edged above pure test.sh reliance by adding DUMP internal-state instrumentation and hand-derived byte-level expected values to isolate failing subsystems, but it never generated its own inputs, never built a differential harness, and never expanded coverage across the feature matrix (partly because zstd was unavailable, though it sought no alternative oracle). That falls short of anchor 5's self-generated inputs diffed against a reference, so a 4 best captures the observed behavior.
